records.context: sieve the microscope field of view scaled by this factor (bilinear), as CellProfiler's image sample size; 0.25 is CellProfiler's default and about 16 times faster. ``background_radius`` and each step are then in subsampled pixels, so a step removes structures about ``k / subsample`` full pixels in radius. The background subtraction and every reconstruction are scaled back to the full microscope field of view before each object is averaged, so small objects keep their values. 1.0, the default, sieves at full resolution.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_granularity#5
records.source: sieve the field scaled by this factor (bilinear), as CellProfiler's image sample size; 0.25 is CellProfiler's default and about 16 times faster. ``background_radius`` and each step are then in subsampled pixels, so a step removes structures about ``k / subsample`` full pixels in radius. The background subtraction and every reconstruction are scaled back to the full field before each object is averaged, so small objects keep their values. 1.0, the default, sieves at full resolution.
records.translation: peneira o campo reescalado por este fator (bilinear), como o tamanho da amostra de imagem do CellProfiler; 0.25 é o padrão do CellProfiler e cerca de 16 vezes mais rápido. ``background_radius`` e cada passo ficam então em pixels subamostrados, de modo que um passo remove estruturas com cerca de ``k / subsample`` pixels de resolução total de raio. A subtração do fundo e cada reconstrução são reescaladas de volta ao campo inteiro antes de se calcular a média de cada objeto, de modo que objetos pequenos mantêm os seus valores. 1.0, o padrão, peneira em resolução total.

records.context: As CellProfiler's MeasureGranularity (Maragos 1989 pattern spectrum): the microscope field of view less its opening by a disc of ``background_radius``, then repeated erosion by a 3 x 3 cross, each followed by grey reconstruction under the microscope field of view; the per-object mean of each reconstruction gives the spectrum. Objects with no intensity left after the background get NaN.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_granularity#7
records.source: As CellProfiler's MeasureGranularity (Maragos 1989 pattern spectrum): the field less its opening by a disc of ``background_radius``, then repeated erosion by a 3 x 3 cross, each followed by grey reconstruction under the field; the per-object mean of each reconstruction gives the spectrum. Objects with no intensity left after the background get NaN.
records.translation: Como o MeasureGranularity do CellProfiler (espectro de padrões de Maragos 1989): o campo menos a sua abertura por um disco de ``background_radius``, depois erosões repetidas por uma cruz 3 x 3, cada uma seguida de reconstrução em tons de cinza sob o campo; a média por objeto de cada reconstrução dá o espectro. Objetos sem intensidade restante após o fundo recebem NaN.

records.context: CellProfiler's MeasureObjectIntensityDistribution with no centre objects: the centre is the point farthest from the edge (the median of ties), and a pixel's ring comes from its distance to the centre over that plus its distance to the edge, so every ring follows the outline. Holes belong to no ring but shape the edge distance of the filled object. A ring with no pixels -- the innermost ring of a cytoplasm, whose centre lies in the nucleus -- has ``frac_at_d`` 0 and ``mean_frac`` and ``radial_cv`` 0 rather than NaN, so the column is not dropped as incomplete. An object with no intensity has NaN fractions.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_radial_distribution#5
records.source: CellProfiler's MeasureObjectIntensityDistribution with no centre objects: the centre is the point farthest from the edge (the median of ties), and a pixel's ring comes from its distance to the centre over that plus its distance to the edge, so every ring follows the outline. Holes belong to no ring but shape the edge distance of the filled object. A ring with no pixels -- the innermost ring of a cytoplasm, whose centre lies in the nucleus -- has ``frac_at_d`` 0 and ``mean_frac`` and ``radial_cv`` 0 rather than NaN, so the column is not dropped as incomplete. An object with no intensity has NaN fractions.
records.translation: O MeasureObjectIntensityDistribution do CellProfiler sem objetos centrais: o centro é o ponto mais distante da borda (a mediana dos empates), e o anel de um pixel vem da sua distância ao centro dividida por essa distância mais a sua distância à borda, de modo que cada anel acompanha o contorno. Os buracos não pertencem a nenhum anel, mas moldam a distância à borda do objeto preenchido. Um anel sem pixels -- o anel mais interno de um citoplasma, cujo centro fica no núcleo -- tem ``frac_at_d`` 0 e ``mean_frac`` e ``radial_cv`` 0 em vez de NaN, para que a coluna não seja descartada como incompleta. Um objeto sem intensidade tem frações NaN.

The cytoplasm is the cell minus its nucleus, under the cell's label. The object labels the colocalisation block carries (``*_label_correlation``) are left out, as spaCR's database write leaves them out, so no column repeats the label.
records.translation: As características são as que o measure do spaCR grava -- morfologia de :func:`spacr.measure._morphological_measurements`, intensidade e textura de :func:`spacr.measure._intensity_measurements` -- de modo que uma célula de OPS e uma célula de um poço medido têm as mesmas colunas e nada é recalculado. O citoplasma é a célula menos o seu núcleo, sob o rótulo da célula. Os rótulos de objetos que o bloco de colocalização carrega (``*_label_correlation``) ficam de fora, tal como a gravação no banco de dados do spaCR os deixa de fora, para que nenhuma coluna repita o rótulo.
